description: Retrieve one pulsar catalog entry by its id, e.g. cousin, exception, silesia. Read-only; returns the entry's name, price, notes, and links. Use when you know the exact entry id; use pulsar_search to find an id by keyword. An unknown id returns an error listing the known ids.

id.description: Entry id within the pulsar catalog, e.g. cousin, exception, silesia. Get the id list from pulsar_search with an empty query; an unknown id returns an error listing the known ids.

name: pulsar_get
